notes: Not standard: C. crescentus cells spiked in before RNA extraction (mixed_organism true). All samples are the CRISPRi oriC strain after arabinose induction (60-240 min); no uninduced control, so no is_control. Strain name differs (SJ_XTL676 in design, CJW7357 in texts), left out. Growth phase not given. M9glyCAAT read as M9 + glycerol + casamino acids (+thiamine).
